source: Rajpurkar et al., CheXNet: Radiologist-Level Pneumonia Detection on Chest X-Rays with Deep Learning, arXiv:1711.05225 (version v3, 25 Dec 2017)
how_read: Values were extracted from the arXiv v3 PDF by a fetch tool and copied here. A reviewer then confirmed Table 1 (page 2: CheXNet 0.435, radiologist average 0.387, radiologist 4 0.442) and Section 4.1 (page 3: difference 0.051, 95% CI 0.005 to 0.084, computed on the same bootstrap samples) against the PDF. I have not myself compared them with the PDF, and the other printed values (the other three individual F1 scores, the intervals for CheXNet and the radiologist average) were not part of that confirmation.
not_stated_in_text_read: number of pneumonia-positive images in the 420
abstract_claim: We find that CheXNet exceeds average radiologist performance on the F1 metric.
